ICP-based list building

FAQ

Common questions

Does cold email still work in 2026? ▾
Yes — when it’s done right. Generic mass blasts are dead. AI-personalized, ICP-targeted email with strong deliverability infrastructure still books meetings at scale. We’ve seen 3–8% reply rates on well-built campaigns.
How long until I see results? ▾
Most clients see their first replies within 2 weeks and start booking calls in weeks 3–4. Full ramp takes 45–60 days as we optimize messaging and deliverability.
What industries work best for cold email? ▾
B2B professional services, healthcare, SaaS, financial services, and home services. If you’re selling to businesses where the deal size is $3K+, cold email has strong economics.
Do you write the emails or do I? ▾
We write everything. You approve the ICP, we handle the research, copywriting, and sequences. You review and approve before we go live.
What do I need to get started? ▾
A clear description of your ideal client and what you sell. We handle the rest — lists, domains, platform setup, copy, and execution.
